bio.text: Matthew Montavon is the Democratic candidate for Florida's 17th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in South Bend, Indiana, earned a bachelor's degree from the Catholic University of America in 1978 and a graduate degree from Indiana University in 1984.
His career experience includes the Peace Corps and planning and financial management roles for governments in West Virginia, Virginia, and Washington, D.C.
